project.title: Initial-state matching and stability diagnostics for a counter-streaming electron-fluid closure
project.summary: Archived initial-state controls and explicit continuum stability diagnostics for arXiv:2607.07106v1.
project.research_question: Do the posted PIC and fluid initializers match physical moments, and does finite isotropization reproduce the stated kinetic longitudinal stability?

claims.text: The archived initial PIC moment current near the lower sheet center is about 11.5 percent below the staggered magnetic-curl target; the PIC proper-momentum initializer and fluid ordinary-velocity initializer do not specify the same physical state.
claims.evidence_summary: Pinned published input decks, selected t=0 moments with CRC32/SHA-256 and stagger-aware deterministic profile analysis.
claims.confidence_note: Moment-current diagnostic and posted fluid initializer, not native deposited current or a new matched-state nonlinear rerun.

claims.text: A specified homogeneous two-Maxwellian equilibrium stable to collisionless longitudinal electrostatic perturbations has an overstable mode in the stated finite-isotropization fluid closure.
claims.evidence_summary: Explicit rational Penrose bound, linear system, eigenvalue residual, dielectric residual and Gauss-constraint checks.
claims.confidence_note: Separate nonrelativistic continuum benchmark; no claim that this mode occurred in the source reconnection simulation or of general electromagnetic stability.

claims.text: A zero normal velocity at a symmetry plane does not prevent density accumulation, and a thermal-to-drift speed ratio alone does not control relative third-moment error near cancellation.
claims.evidence_summary: Retained periodic continuity proof, conditioned error estimate and deterministic mixture checks.
claims.confidence_note: Does not invalidate the exact mixture identities or independently disprove the original empirical scan.
